definitions.explanation: Things of the same kind as the one mentioned: その{類|たぐい}の{話|はなし}, "that sort of story". Slightly literary; often after a noun with の, or after a list.

definitions.gloss: an equal; a match (in 類まれな)
definitions.explanation: Something that compares with another. Survives mainly in {類|たぐい}まれな, "rare, matchless", and {類|たぐい}のない, "unparalleled", used in praise.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{類|たぐい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I often hear that sort of story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類|たぐい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信|しん}じない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: I don't believe in fortune-telling and that kind of thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧や⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類|たぐい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There were hardly any comics, games or things like that in his room.

examples.japanese: {類|たぐい}まれな⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{類|たぐい}まれな{美声|びせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: She has a voice of rare beauty.
The garden of this temple is said to be of unparalleled beauty, even by world standards.

notes:
Also written {類|たぐ}い. The same kanji read るい is the ordinary Sino-Japanese word for "kind, class" (⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友|とも}→友：03466_tomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧, birds of a feather flock together).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- N⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{類|たぐい}: N and the like
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{類|たぐい}: that sort of thing
- {類|たぐい}まれな: rare, matchless
- {類|たぐい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unparalleled

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: kind, type — the everyday word
- ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧: and so on — the plain way to list examples
